name: Natural Earth Admin 0 Countries
transformations: Preserve all source country IDs, names, islands and polygon holes; round coordinates to five decimals.
Repair invalid source polygon topology with Shapely make_valid for intersection and union.
Keep Chinese parent/display overrides in the runtime.
RUS/KAZ partition uses the contiguous Natural Earth EUROPE Urals/Ural River path; offshore endpoint extensions are overview conventions.
TUR source land polygons are assigned using Natural Earth continent regions, without artificial meridian/parallel cuts.
precisionNote: 1:10M generalized geography, historical raster coastlines and overview continent conventions; not a survey or an administrative delimitation.
